records.subject: spec-guard-0.60.0-codex-copy
evidence: result:both run green from the installed copy (phase-guard 298 cases, project link 32 cases)
command:codex exec -s workspace-write (each session registers itself with "$CODEX_THREAD_ID") / codex exec resume <thread id>, run in the shared session directory

result:in a temporary layout (two enabled projects and one shared session directory that is not enabled) two real sessions were each registered to a different project with `link-project set --session`; resumed, each quoted a `Linked project` paragraph naming its own project and saying the session is linked by its own entry; a third, unregistered session in the same directory answered that there was no spec-guard context

result:each session registered itself by passing its own CODEX_THREAD_ID; the trust entry codex exec added to ~/.codex/config.toml for the temporary directory was the only difference and was removed afterwards
